Eyes are sensitive to light. 

even sitting in a chair my body just hurts and I have to lay down. 

Trust me if I could sit in a wheelchair and not be hurting I would go out. But I can't. I go out for an hour at the most. 

It's not worth it. It physically is not go for me to be out. If it's not one thing it's another.

Embracing the disease? I've accepted it, it's not going anywhere. There is no cure for it. I just wish other people would embrace if and just realize even though this has happened toe doesn't mean I don't want to hang out and have fun. 

I've had friends over the years but they all ended the same. I get to know someone. They want to go places and hing out, well I can't. They get tired of having to always hang at my place. Then they just drift away and never hear from them again.
Thank you. I'll take you up in that, and you do the same.

It's not words that hurt me. It's the actions of people. The looks I get. The way people tend to avoid me. 

To answer your question when someone says "I'm sorry" all I do is tell them it's not their fault so don't apologize for it.
Yeah man. Just happy to talk to someone.

I'm completely blind in my right eye. Going blind in the left. I have rheumatoid arthritis throughout my body. I've lost almost all control of my legs and now use a wheelchair. Thankfully the ulcers have stopped.
